title: Clean, modern boat with great service
text: We had a well organised, great trip with attentive service. The boat was modern and comfortable with plenty of seating. The staff were super organised and had everybody served with drinks in no time. Plenty to see, if anything I wish it had gone on a little longer!
author: LouiseW146

title: Fun trip
text: Really good fun. We all enjoyed this river cruise, driver was informative.
author: RJP1066

title: Nice
text: One hour slow short river cruise. Nice staff. We heard about things in Spanish and English. If you booked through Viator don’t look for that sign ✌️
author: Kerry_W

title: PHENOMENAL
text: The boat was great, there were white sofas with a table to have a drink. It did not make any noise and the railings were made of glass so you could see everything great. We saw other boats stopped next to this one and they were terrible. I recommend booking this one, it has nothing to do with the others and besides, not many people fit so there is no shouting or mess.
author: mercedesrD6576XZ

title: Nice thing to do
text: Very relaxing with this maritime tour of the city between several bridges, friendly staff, water available to drink on site, nice in case of high heat
author: Pontiac1

title: Comfortable and enjoyable ride
text: Very comfortable and enjoyable ride. Great view of the city and having the bar service was a bonus.
author: carlolV1703OC

title: It's an experience...
text: It's an incredible experience. In addition to the environment you sail through, you have the attention of the staff accompanying us on the trip, who were attentive to anyone who needed it the whole time, with kindness. We will return next year and repeat the trip. Congratulations and thanks to everyone.
author: Juanjo_C

title: Interesting cruise
text: It is a very interesting experience. A ride along the river while you listen to a little bit of the city's history.
author: Lidia_S

title: Perfect for spending time with family
text: We loved it! I recommend it 100%. Tasty drinks, music, the tour is in three languages, which is a bit tedious but I understand it.
author: TERESA_G

title: A good time
text:
The boat staff is very pleasant, the boat is comfortable and well-shaded, the view of the city is superb, it's a real plus to be able to order a drink at the bar! 
Bonus points for the electric boat powered by solar panels
author: PrisssMo
